# AirportTransfers Zürich

> Private airport transfer service from Zurich Airport (ZRH) to all of
> Switzerland. Fixed prices, Mercedes-Benz fleet, meet & greet, flight
> tracking, free child seats and ski bags, available 24/7.
> Languages: English (default, /en) and German (/de).

Operated by Kula-ZATK, Industristrasse 14, 8302 Kloten, Switzerland.
Phone/WhatsApp: +41 76 302 03 26.

## Services
- Private airport transfers ZRH → whole of Switzerland at fixed prices (per vehicle, incl. VAT)
- Vehicle classes: Business (Mercedes E-Class), Business & Family (V-Class, 7 pax),
  Premium (S-Class), VIP (V300 Maybach)
- Meet & greet in the arrivals hall, free waiting time, real-time flight tracking
- Free baby seats, child seats and ski bags; payment by cash, card or TWINT in the vehicle
